author: kingpanther13
releaseNotes:
v4.8.4 - 2026-10-24
- ci: run the fast lanes on stacked PRs and harden the e2e lane gates (#560)
- fix: log every ordinary write to the MCP log and make the lost-response hint era-aware (#532)
  - Every write now leaves short `started` / `finished` records in the MCP log (`hub_get_logs(mode='mcp', component='write')`) with the tool, target identifiers, a correlation id, the request id you sent and an outcome (completed, failed, partial, accepted, unknown), recorded regardless of the MCP log level, so a client that lost a response can find out what happened without debug logging.
  - The lost-response guidance now matches the client: older-protocol clients are pointed at the write log and target readback (their writes never appear in `recentWrites`); 2026-07-28 clients are told `recentWrites` covers continuation writes only. Both say a lost response leaves the outcome uncertain and a missing record does not prove the write never ran.

v4.8.3 - 2026-10-20
- fix(deps): update dependency net.bytebuddy:byte-buddy to v1.18.15-jdk5 ([#557](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/557), @app/renovate)
- chore(deps): update dependency renovate to v44.168.1 ([#558](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/558), @app/renovate)
- fix: #511 findings reproduced live (#556)
  - Hub events such as restarts and low-memory warnings now show in the location event history.
  - Dashboards list with their full settings again, so reading and updating an Easy Dashboard keeps its theme and PINs.
  - Hub info and metrics report memory, temperature and database size as numbers, with the database size in MB, and count every device the assistant can reach.
  - Visual Rules list paused rules correctly, including rules whose name contains "(Paused)".
  - Creating a mode returns its id; a device created through the assistant is added to its device selection; a failed device replace explains the hub's answer.
  - Long attribute waits over the cloud stop in time and say so instead of failing.
  - Apps and drivers can be listed by name; Rule Machine rule names show as typed.
  - Restoring a backup from a URL explains why a URL was refused, accepts File Manager files with spaces in their names, and shows sizes with a decimal.
  - Source code, files and the full tool guide are read in smaller pieces by default, so the first read fits in the assistant's limits.

v4.8.2 - 2026-10-18
- fix: read app and driver versions from the code list, not the single-item read (#554)
  - Updating the MCP package with `hub_update_package` no longer leaves the hub with less free memory after each update, and the update finishes sooner.

v4.8.1 - 2026-10-18
- fix: end a legacy hub_list_devices page at the request budget (#553)
  - Listing devices over the cloud from an MCP client that does not support request continuation no longer times out on large hubs. A page that runs out of time returns the devices read so far with `budgetLimited: true` and a `nextCursor` to fetch the rest.
  - A tool result over 99,000 bytes on the cloud connection (the relay was seen dropping responses of 104,261 bytes and more) now comes back as a `response_too_large` answer naming how to narrow the call, instead of a gateway timeout.
  - `hub_list_backups` returns code backups 50 at a time, newest first, with a `nextCursor` for the next page.

v4.8.0 - 2026-10-17
- feat: per-client access tokens with their own tool, read/write and connection access (#551)
  - New under Advanced settings: per-client access tokens (firmware 2.5.2 or later). Give an MCP client its own token (all tools on to start) and choose exactly which tools it can call, whether it can read or write, whether it can connect locally or through the cloud, and its own tool-name number. The main token is unchanged.
    - A client sees only its own tools, and a refused call tells it which setting blocks it. A client token can never read or change the MCP Rule Server app itself, and access tokens are always masked in its results.
    - Rotating or revoking a client token takes effect immediately and leaves every other client working.
